description: This file defines a React component library for an alert dialog UI, wrapping Radix UI primitives with custom styling and structure.

methods.name: AlertDialog
methods.description: Main component wrapping Radix AlertDialog.Root with additional props.

methods.name: AlertDialogTrigger
methods.description: Component for triggering the alert dialog, wrapping Radix Trigger.

methods.name: AlertDialogPortal
methods.description: Component rendering the portal for the dialog content.

methods.name: AlertDialogOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation for the dialog background.

methods.name: AlertDialogContent
methods.description: Main content container for the dialog, including overlay and styling.

methods.name: AlertDialogHeader
methods.description: Header section of the dialog, typically for title or header content.

methods.name: AlertDialogFooter
methods.description: Footer section for actions like buttons.

methods.name: AlertDialogCancel
methods.description: Cancel button to close the dialog.
